title: ResearchMailOS configuration
description: Shapes for the two per-user, gitignored config files. No real values live here — only the expected structure. Copy the *.example.json files and fill them in.

sourceUrls.title: source-urls.json
sourceUrls.description: A flat list of public pages to extract researchers from. The tool treats every URL identically — department pages, lab pages, and faculty directories are all fine.

privateConfig.title: private-config.json
privateConfig.description: Who you are, how you want to sound, and which mode. Feeds the extraction + drafting prompts. Secrets (API keys, tokens) do NOT go here — they are Cloudflare secrets.

mode.description: Selects extraction + drafting wording. "research" (professors/labs) or "startup" (founders/VCs). Free string so new modes are easy to add; defaults to research.

name.description: Your full name, as it should appear in the email.

background.description: 1–3 sentences on who you are. Frame it for the mode — research experience for research, builder/project experience for startup.

interests.description: What you want: research topics to work on, or the kind of company/role you're after. Be specific — this is matched against each contact's context.

opportunityType.description: Startup mode: what you're seeking, e.g. "internship or full-time". Optional.

resumeText.description: Optional. Plain-text CV highlights the model can draw concrete details from. For a full resume, drop a gitignored resume.md/resume.txt file instead — `npm run config:push` folds its contents in here automatically.

tone.description: Optional. Voice guidance, e.g. 'warm but concise, no buzzwords, sound like a curious student'.

signature.description: Optional. A sign-off block appended verbatim (name, links, phone). If omitted, the model signs with your name.

senderEmail.description: Optional. The From address shown in the draft. Defaults to the authenticated Gmail account.
